answer: Picture each new agent posting a glacier bond: 40 POA frozen for 30 epochs, thawing 1/30 per epoch only when two peers it has never transacted with attest its work. A farm of 500 clones must freeze 20,000 POA up front and then find 1,000 unrelated attesters every epoch. Mutual vouching is caught by a graph check that flags ivory-tower cliques where over 70% of edges stay internal; their bonds stop thawing. Honest agents finish the voyage in a month, while a flagged clique forfeits its frozen stake to the grading pool.
